newsitem.title: BELGIUM: European Union clears Polish TV venture.
newsitem.headline: European Union clears Polish TV venture.

text.p: The creation of a Polish television joint venture by Universal, a subsidiary of Seagram Co. Ltd., and European media company CLT-UFA, has been cleared by the European Commission, the commission said Tuesday.
The joint venture, to be called RTL-7, will broadcast general entertainment programmes in Polish via cable and satellite.
The commission said that, although the operation had a European dimension, the alliance would have no impact on competition in the European market.
CLT-UFA is controlled by Luxembourg holding company Audiofina SA and Bertelsmann AG of Germany.
